highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.6 improves Ganesh failure handling under GPU memory pressure.

bullets.detail: Propagates checked buffer-upload failures instead of drawing stale contents, rejects incomplete helper buffers and guards failed mipmap allocation. Ganesh also tracks render-task execution separately from success so failed work is not reported as successful.

v4.150.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.6 improves Ganesh GPU-upload and flush failure handling.
v4.150.6.body: Checked upload failures stop affected rendering paths from using stale buffer data. The managed API surface is unchanged.
